findings.finding: Arm (c) ran each printed command once. The lesson it implements is explicit that once is not enough -- "run every command exactly as printed, twice where it writes into a persistent state directory, and assert the two runs give the same RESULT line". A command that answers differently the second time is a printed promise that is true once, and a single run cannot tell the difference.
